## Addendum: log-collision audit, and the actual source of the host saturation

**A `/tmp` filename collision nearly contaminated the previous comment's evidence.** While
checking for orphaned processes I found that ANOTHER agent session, working in
`/Users/joeoakhart/fix-caused-by-lagging-checkout`, is running its own `make verify`
redirected to **the same path I used, `/tmp/verify2.log`**. That file's mtime (21:17) is five
minutes LATER than my own rc file (21:12), so its early bytes were rewritten by that session
after my run had finished.

I re-derived the census rather than trusting the earlier `grep` over the whole file. Scoping
strictly to the region after the last `short test summary info` marker: the file contains
**exactly one** summary block, and it lists **exactly 14** failures, matching its own
`14 failed` total. So the analysis in the previous comment is correct as written — the
collision overwrote only low offsets, never the summary region. Recording the check because
the previous comment's conclusion would otherwise rest on a file another process had written
to, and that is not a basis anyone should have to take on trust.

Lesson carried forward: unique per-session `/tmp` paths for any log a long run writes.

**The saturation now has a full explanation.** It is not just the three `review-plan` gates.
`scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` and a process listing show **three concurrent `make verify`
runs on this one host**, from three different checkouts:

- `/Users/joeoakhart/fix-pinned-view-packed` (mine, since finished)
- `/Users/joeoakhart/fix-alias-resolve-scan` (pid 48413, another session)
- `/Users/joeoakhart/fix-caused-by-lagging-checkout` (pid 99391, another session)

plus three `rebar review-plan` processes from `/Users/joeoakhart/comment-gates-current`. Six
concurrent heavyweight consumers, against a 4-slot host semaphore — which is why the second
run took 1:23:50 and why the serial union re-run found zero slots free. Nothing here is
attributable to the change, and none of it is mine to clear.

**Orphan check clean:** the only PPID-1 orphan on the host is `Caffeine.app`, a user
application. This session leaked no processes; every helper it started has been reaped.
